import hashlib, json, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/research/csv-fixed-price-buyer-test')
source = base / 'navigation.xml'
raw = source.read_bytes()
items = []
for item in ET.fromstring(raw).findall('./channel/item')[:10]:
    items.append({'title': item.findtext('title', default='').strip(), 'url': item.findtext('link', default='').strip()})
result = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'items': items, 'scope': 'Search navigation only. Original buyer briefs govern current status, paid scope, eligibility and reply routes.'}
output = base / 'navigation-readback.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
